records.context: ``score(n, subsample_seed)`` caps every gene and control guide at ``n`` cells (``default_rng(seed + 100 + subsample_seed)``, genes in sorted order, then the control guides); ``n`` None keeps every cell. Only empirical-null mode uses one median-sized null. Query guide blocks participate in their permutation null. Assignments use ``default_rng(seed + 300 + subsample_seed)``; Monte Carlo sampling includes the observed assignment and uses add-one p-values. records.translation: 在向导零分布模式下，此诊断混合使用将符合条件的真实基因限制为最多 ``n`` 个细胞后得到的精确向导细胞数配置。它仅使用 NT 向导构成的伪基因进行效应量诊断，抽样使用 ``default_rng(seed + 11 + n)`` 和 ``default_rng(seed + 12 + n)``。基因 p 值则按其精确观测配置使用包含待检向导的完整向导块置换，不使用这些数组。

records.context: Guide-null p-values permute intact query and NT guide blocks within exact cell-count strata; only held-out NT guides appear as diagnostic rows. Its held-out pseudo-genes follow the frequency of profiles among scored genes. The table adds ``permutation_space`` (decimal string, or power-of-two bounds for huge spaces), ``permutation_draws``, ``permutation_resolution``, ``permutation_exact`` and ``permutation_supported``. Exact enumeration excludes the observed assignment from the draw count and adds it once to the denominator. Unsupported genes retain p=1; unsupported optional diagnostics retain NaN. Summary counts identify unsupported and coarse-resolution rows, and false-positive diagnostic percentages use only finite p-values.

records.translation: 向导零分布 p 值在精确细胞数分层内置换完整的待检向导块和 NT 向导块；仅留出的 NT 向导作为诊断行出现。其留出伪基因遵循已评分基因中各配置的频率。表中增加 ``permutation_space``（十进制字符串，空间极大时为二的幂表示的上下界）、``permutation_draws``、``permutation_resolution``、``permutation_exact`` 和 ``permutation_supported``。精确枚举的抽样次数不包含观测到的分配，并在分母中将其计入一次。不支持的基因保留 p=1；不支持的可选诊断保留 NaN。汇总计数标明不支持及分辨率较粗的行，假阳性诊断百分比仅使用有限的 p 值。
